changelog:
• Removed SMS OTP across the entire app — Email OTP (Firebase + Brevo) is now used exclusively for registration and password reset.
• Enforced 12–64 character password policy (uppercase, lowercase, numeric, special character) with Require/Notify modes and Force Upgrade on Sign-In.
• Added 3-tier anti-abuse rate limiting (Per IP: 8 sign-ups/hr, Per Device ID: 2 sign-ups/hr, Per Email/Phone: 4 OTP requests/hr).
